preconditions.description: The lengths of s1 and s2 must be between 1 and 1000.
The lengths of s1 and s2 must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1) and all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: Both s1 and s2 must only contain the characters 'x' and 'y'.

postconditions.description: If the total count of 'x' in both strings is odd, return -1 indicating impossibility.
The return value must be non-negative if a valid swap count is possible.
The return value must represent the minimum number of swaps required to make s1 and s2 equal.
